rules.sentence: It has the worst prognosis among all lymphoma subtypes with a median overall survival of 5 years.
Despite that, it has a wide range of presentations, and in some older patients, it has a very slowly progressive course where close surveillance without immediate treatment initiation has been used.
It usually presents as a widespread disease; bone marrow and gastrointestinal tract are the most common sites of involvement.
In the gastrointestinal tract, it can cause obstruction due to the formation of multiple polyps, a condition called lymphomatous polyposis.
